sources.principle: Google selects representative canonical URLs for duplicate clusters; declared and Google-selected canonicals can differ.
sources.title: En quoi consiste le choix de l'URL canonique ? | Google Search Central | Documentation | Google for Developers

sources.principle: Redirects, rel=canonical, sitemaps, and internal-link consistency are canonical signals; signals should not conflict.
sources.title: 如何使用 rel="canonical" 和其他方法指定標準網址 | Google 搜尋中心 | Documentation | Google for Developers

sources.principle: Permanent redirects communicate durable URL moves; redirect targets should remain relevant and technically valid.
sources.title: リダイレクトと Google 検索 | Google 検索セントラル | Documentation | Google for Developers

sources.principle: Map URLs one-to-one, change major systems separately where practical, update internal links, monitor, and retain redirects for at least a year.
sources.title: Site Moves and Migrations | Google Search Central | Documentation | Google for Developers

sources.principle: Important internal links should be crawlable anchors with descriptive, relevant anchor text.
sources.title: SEO Link Best Practices for Google | Google Search Central | Documentation | Google for Developers

sources.principle: Sitemaps should list preferred canonical URLs that the publisher wants surfaced in Search.
